Ronaldo clarifies retirement plans ahead of World Cup match

Portuguese captain Cristiano Ronaldo has stated that the 2026 FIFA World Cup will be his last. He made this announcement during a press conference before Portugal's match against Spain. Ronaldo also asserted that he does not make decisions without careful consideration, addressing claims made by his sister.
